component.name: Guardian Antivirus
component.summary: Scan files and watch folders for malware

description.p: Guardian is a desktop virus scanner built on ClamAV. It scans files and folders, watches the folders you choose, and isolates threats in quarantine.

ul.li: Quick, home-folder and custom scans that skip files unchanged since they were last found clean
Real-time monitoring of chosen folders, with a notice when a new download has been checked
A second opinion from known-malware fingerprints and YARA-X rules
Key-free VirusTotal lookups that send only a file's fingerprint, never the file
Quarantine with restore, scheduled scans and USB drive scanning

description.p: This package includes its own ClamAV and downloads virus definitions itself.
Faster scans that skip unchanged files, hash-lookup and YARA-X second opinions, VirusTotal lookups, a Suspicious status, pause and resume, and a Flatpak package.
